name: Agent messaging and deliberation
userOutcome: Agents can exchange focused asynchronous questions and convene bounded auditable deliberations without pausing unrelated work.
productionDataSource: Agent runs, tasks, messages, fact packages, deliberation rounds, positions, and decisions.
errorBehavior: Preserve sent messages and independent positions, identify unresolved blockers, and expire or escalate rooms that exceed limits.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not use an unbounded permanent group chat.
Do not reveal initial positions before required independent responses finish.
Do not treat transcript text as a canonical decision until recorded.
acceptanceTests: Ask and resolve a direct blocking question.
